name: sidebar
description: A docked sidebar for widget mods (checklist, questions, processes, and any other): one tab per widget, or one stacked pane

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: tabs: one pane per widget, shown as tabs that open when the widget has something and close when it empties. stacked: one pane with every widget's section stacked.

order.title: Section order
order.description: Comma-separated widget names: top to bottom when stacked, tab order when several tabs open at once. Widgets not named here follow in the order they first appeared.
